questions.question: Identify three (3) common types of bars.
Identify two (2) different types of service available in most bars.
The term ‘mise en place’ means …
options: to put everything in place for bar service
to put up everything on display
answer_texts: to put everything in place for bar service

questions.question: What are three (3) possible examples of organisational procedures for displaying stock and ancillary products?
options: Displays must display specials, popular products, etc.
Displays need to be replenished as items are used
Displays must be used to promote not popular items
Displays need to include ancillary items that could generate add-on sales
answer_texts: Displays must display specials, popular products, etc.
Displays need to be replenished as items are used
Displays need to include ancillary items that could generate add-on sales

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an example of ‘mise en place’ procedure.
options: Connecting draught beer to service point

questions.question: What requirement commonly applies to the presentation of packaged beverage, e.g., bottle, stubby, can, etc., to a patron?
Identify five (5) standard requirements that apply to the presentation of beverages in glasses to patrons?
options: Glasses to be held by stem or base
Glass type to be chosen by patron
Garnished to be placed in/on glass
Glasses to be filled by patrons
Glasses not to be chipped or cracked
answer_texts: Glasses to be held by stem or base
Garnished to be placed in/on glass
Glasses not to be chipped or cracked

questions.question: Identify five (5) examples of closing procedures of a bar?
options: Turn on glasswasher to wash glasses over night
Wash drip trays, post-mix machines, ice buckets, etc
Place bar towels to dry for next session
Dispose or recycle empty bottles and cans
answer_texts: Wash drip trays, post-mix machines, ice buckets, etc
Dispose or recycle empty bottles and cans

questions.question: What is the standard procedure in a bar for replenishing stock used during service?
options: Making a list of required drinks on notice board
Completing a requisition form with bar name, date, items required, brand, size, and quantity
Verbally inform bar supervisor which items are required
answer_texts: Completing a requisition form with bar name, date, items required, brand, size, and quantity

questions.question: Identify three (3) key requirements you may need to prepare a variety of mixed drinks in a bar.
options: Different glass types for variety of drinks
Appropriate garnishes for the type of drinks served
Variety of ingredients for alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks
Drink decorations such as umbrellas, straws, etc
answer_texts: Different glass types for variety of drinks
Appropriate garnishes for the type of drinks served
Variety of ingredients for alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks

questions.question: What are three (3) key requirements you may need to prepare for draught beer service in a bar?
options: Complete tasks in the cellar such as tapping, connecting beer and gas
Check operation of the draught beer dispensing and refrigeration system
answer_texts: Complete tasks in the cellar such as tapping, connecting beer and gas
Check operation of the draught beer dispensing and refrigeration system

Select three (3) crucial steps to check a POS system as an opening of the bar procedure.
options: The date and time a correct on the system
The system is linked to order points
The EFTPOS is placed on counter
